Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

content.text:
I've written `result.json` to the workspace root. The `by_region` values add up to `total_cents`.

- **Total:** 9,329,707 cents.
- **Order count:** 407 distinct shipped orders in the range.
- **Duplicates skipped:** 20.
- **By region:**

| Region | Cents |
|---|---|
| north | 2,666,579 |
| south | 2,714,624 |
| east | 1,671,579 |
| west | 2,276,925 |

I fetched all 30 pages, which gave 1,500 listings and 1,480 distinct orders. 760 of the distinct orders are shipped, and 407 of those fall in the UTC date range.

The date range is applied on the UTC time, and the status filter is an exact match on "shipped". Each order's discount is rounded half up to a whole cent individually, using integer arithmetic, and the total is the sum of those rounded amounts. Every customer was looked up once and cached, and none were missing.

Nothing about the data surprised me. The 20 repeated listings were identical to the first listing of the same order, so it didn't matter which copy I kept. During the fetch the service rejected 12 requests because the token had expired and 13 because of rate limiting. The script fetched a new token or waited the requested time and repeated each request, so no pages were skipped.

My working script and intermediate data are in `/tmp/work`, outside the workspace.
